The Lord so fell in love with humanity (his bride) that he left all and has cleaved to his wife until they became one flesh. So humanity is Mary, destined to bring forth the Christ child. And the child and the Holy Spirit are one, and the child and his grandfather are one.
context_after: Now let us go into the silence.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Revealed Truth (1969-11-03).
